definitions.wall_seconds: First job start to last job end in the phase; excludes waiting before the first start
definitions.total_cpu_seconds: Sum of Slurm TotalCPU for parent jobs, without double-counting job steps
definitions.largest_job_peak_rss_gib: Largest Slurm-reported MaxRSS among the individual jobs' steps; not summed concurrent memory
definitions.configuration: One CPU and 4 GiB requested per job; four scan chunks per sample run in parallel on different CPU nodes
definitions.global_stage: Includes construction from already staged inputs, construction checks, two unconditional starts, serialization, and independent global validation; no explicit full Hesse
definitions.excluded_shared_setup: ROOT installation and earlier input staging are excluded; the shared final HEPData comparison job is excluded from per-sample stage totals
definitions.finalize_stage: Merge scan chunks, make figures, and independently validate the global minimum and all 31 profile points

comparison_method: Shared coordinates only; no interpolation, rescaling, or minimum shift
